failuresAndCorrections.issue: Native WAD dyld image index was assumed; inactive inspectors had no mainWindow
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Locate MH_EXECUTE, instruction-check native importer; wait for constructed Dolphin window. Synthetic and two real WAD fixtures pass. Initial disposable crash retained as diagnostic evidence.

failuresAndCorrections.issue: Switch metadata fields inferred from source did not match supplied native 1.3.3; empty CRC was treated as zero
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Use actual native is_enabled/path fields and absent empty checksum. Actual Quest update and five DLCs pass.

failuresAndCorrections.issue: Concurrent native GUI test stole AppKit focus; firmware check failed pause readback despite native 22.5.0/game load
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Run focus-sensitive native GUI checks sequentially; unchanged isolated provisioning/game check passes.

failuresAndCorrections.issue: Explicit RetroArch -s bypassed per-core save-directory initialization; Cocoa close raced save flushing; native QUIT had a confirmation gate
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Use native basename/private directory, preserve ZIP inner identities, stop SDL sampling without closing Cocoa, disable confirmation and let verified QUIT flush saves. Six native ordinary-save fixtures and SNES close pass.

failuresAndCorrections.issue: Arcade cached test used numeric filename instead of original konami88.zip
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Preserve ROMset filename, as production library already does. Arcade native gameplay/state check passes.

failuresAndCorrections.issue: Retained snapshot verification did not recognize new Wii DLC save area
failuresAndCorrections.resolution: Add the explicit DLC area in native import, snapshot and recovery checks; base/DLC/retained round trips pass.
